Swedish application security company Detectify AB today launched Agentic Tooling, a set of tools aimed at letting an organization’s own artificial intelligence agents test whether suspected vulnerabilities can be exploited in running applications. A new Security Ledger, also part of the launch, is designed to record the evidence behind each test. Detectify is pitching the release […]
